s3.desc: Open the launcher, log in with your credentials, and hit Play. Choose Elyos or Asmodian, create your character, and enter Atreia.

faq.title: Common issues
faq.a1: Run as Administrator. Make sure antivirus is not blocking the file. Add the launcher folder to antivirus exceptions.
faq.a2: Update your GPU drivers. If using an AMD card, disable Radeon Anti-Lag. Try running in windowed mode first.
faq.a3: Server is in Frankfurt, Germany. If your ping is above 100ms, try a gaming VPN like ExitLag or Mudfish. Disable background downloads.
faq.a4: Delete the bin32/aion.bin.old file in your game folder. If it persists, run File Repair in the launcher.
